title: High CPU utilization alerts
problem: VPS performance is degraded and console shows 100% CPU usage.
cause: Application loop or insufficient resources for the workload on the current flavor.
solution: Access via SSH or Web Console.
Run `top` or `htop` to identify the runaway process.
If workload is legitimate, resize the instance to a larger flavor (for example, from an illustrative 'fc.standard.small' to 'fc.standard.large').
